1_pb_trap_cleanup_termination_confirmed.finding: R15 cleared RELEASE1B_PB_PID=0 immediately after wait without confirming the process had stopped
1_pb_trap_cleanup_termination_confirmed.fix: After wait, poll kill -0 for up to 5 seconds (10 x 0.5s). If process still alive: send SIGKILL, set CLEANUP_FAILURE=1. Then clear PID.
1_pb_trap_cleanup_termination_confirmed.policy: CLEANUP_FAILURE — PocketBase still running after kill is a cleanup failure, not a halt

2_concurrency_worker_exit_codes.finding: R15 dropped worker exit codes (bare :); result classification could not distinguish helper crash from functional test failure
2_concurrency_worker_exit_codes.fix: Subshell uses explicit exit $rc to propagate pbj_http.py exit code. Parent captures all worker_rcs via wait array. Four outcome categories: (1) worker nonzero -> t_harness_err; (2) result file absent -> t_harness_err; (3) result file malformed -> t_harness_err; (4) functional wrong status -> t_fail
2_concurrency_worker_exit_codes.policy: harness errors and test failures independently tracked and reported

4_final_exit_condition.finding: R15 final exit checked only T_BLOCKING and T_FAIL; T_HARNESS_ERR and CLEANUP_FAILURE not checked
